_meta.description: Manifest navigation + index/detail pages for the unified AnalyticalDimension register (REQ-ADIM-103). Three filtered views: CostCenters (dimensionType=cost-center), KostenDragers (dimensionType=cost-object), AnalyticalDimensions (dimensionType=custom). CostCenters / KostenDragers / Projects nav items already live in src/manifest.json; this fragment adds the AnalyticalDimensions (custom) nav leaf + its index/detail pages, plus the SegmentPnLDashboard. Labels unified per EN-primary convention: Cost centers / Kostenplaatsen, Cost objects / Kostendragers, Analytical dimensions / Analytische dimensies.

config._note: An analytical dimension is a MASTER reference record — a bookkeeping axis (cost centre / cost object / custom) that GL transaction lines are tagged against for segment reporting. Body leads with the definition (code, data type, hierarchy, optional reference register/schema for open-list values); the segment-P&L aggregation rolls up the postings that carry this dimension so the accountant sees its financial weight without a fragile per-line filter. No comms — a chart-of-accounts master; audit trail in a sidebar tab to evidence dimension changes.

pages.title: Segment P&L
pages._note: The whole page is one table whose GROUPING AXIS is chosen at runtime: selector chips switch the source between the four x-openregister-aggregations on GLLine (byCostCenter, byCostCenterHierarchy, byProject, byAnalyticalDimension), with hierarchical roll-up and a CSV export (REQ-CD-004 / REQ-CD-007). A `type: dashboard` widget binds to ONE fixed aggregation, so expressing this declaratively would need four pages and still lose the shared roll-up state. The page also degrades to a client-side rollup of raw GLLine rows when the aggregation endpoint 404s on older OpenRegister builds.
